reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 和家人看电影的具体需要

materials.title: Cinema Family Rules 032
materials.text: At the cinema, wait in the lobby until the helper opens the hall. Remove tall hats so people behind can see. Keep phones dark during the film. Ask the helper for a booster seat if a child cannot see. Return borrowed booster seats after the film.

questions.prompt: A friend pushes at the closed hall door. You say, "____"
options: Wait in the lobby for the helper.
questions.explanation: A帮手开厅前大堂等；B硬推、C爬票窗不是许可入场。

questions.prompt: Your friend’s tall hat blocks the person behind. You say, "____"
options: Please take the tall hat off.
Put the hat on the seat behind.
questions.explanation: B取高帽使后人可见；A更高、C移后座仍占用他人视线空间。

questions.prompt: A child cannot see over the seat ahead. You say, "____"
options: Ask the helper for a booster seat.
questions.explanation: C向帮手求增高座是提供的安排；A站他人、B不求助放弃非解决。

questions.prompt: A friend turns on a bright phone during the film. You say, "____"
options: Keep the phone dark during the film.
questions.explanation: A影片时手机保持暗；B更亮、C举全席均违规则。

questions.prompt: The film ends, and a friend wants to take the borrowed booster seat away. You say, "____"
options: Throw it in the food bin.
questions.explanation: B借座结束归还；A藏带走、C丢食物桶不合。

materials.title: Icecream Shop Speaking 032
materials.text: A child is buying ice cream with family. Choose the sentence that meets each clearly stated need.

questions.prompt: You want ice cream in a cup, not a cone. What do you say?
options: Please put it in my shoe.
Please give me only a cone.
questions.explanation: A明确要杯不蛋筒；B鞋不作容器；C只筒与需求相反。

questions.prompt: You did not hear the flavours the seller named. What do you ask?
options: Could you tell me the flavours again?
questions.explanation: B请求再说口味以便选择；A改全部口味非听漏澄清；C冰柜走路无关。

questions.prompt: Ice cream drips on your hand. You need a napkin. What do you say?
options: May I have a napkin, please?
questions.explanation: C索纸巾处理滴手；A更多滴、B藏纸巾反需要。

questions.prompt: You receive a straw but need a spoon for the cup. What do you say?
options: May I have a spoon instead of a straw?
May I have a bigger road?
May I take the freezer home?
questions.explanation: A纠餐具为勺；B大路、C带冰柜不解决吃杯装冰淇淋。

questions.prompt: The seller asks if you want another scoop. You want only the one already in the cup. What do you say?
options: No, thank you. One scoop is enough.
Put every scoop on the floor.
questions.explanation: B明确一勺够，谢绝添加；A全桶超需；C地上丢不回应所需量。

units.title: 玩具店参观的十段句子

materials.title: Toy Shop Ten Sentences 032
materials.text: Choose the correct word or reply for each complete toy-shop visit situation.

questions.prompt: This toy robot ____ when I press the large button.
questions.explanation: A robot单三谓语moves；B原形不配单三；C分词缺be。

questions.prompt: The little cars belong to us. They are ____ cars.
questions.explanation: B belongs to us对应our；A他们、C他的非本句物主。

questions.prompt: There are two toy ____ in the pond display.
questions.explanation: C fish本义常见同形复数；A fishs错，B fishes再加es错。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the toy on its stand after trying it.
questions.explanation: A祈使原形put；B单三、C分词均不独立构成指令。

questions.prompt: The train is behind the glass. We can look, but we must not ____.
questions.explanation: B must not后touch原形且不触展品；A looking分词、C单三不合。

questions.prompt: How much is this small bear? It is ____ yuan.
questions.explanation: C yuan前数词ten答价格；A柔软、B棕色非金额。

questions.prompt: The helper speaks to me. I listen to ____ carefully. She explains the game.
questions.explanation: A listen to后宾格her，后She明确；B主格、C物主不作该人物宾语。

questions.prompt: ____ toy is for a baby? The soft one in the basket.
questions.explanation: B Which toy问哪件；A何时、C何地不限定toy作所问对象。

questions.prompt: The box is empty now. There are ____ blocks inside.
questions.explanation: C no与empty一致；A肯定句any非无块表达，B a不接复数blocks。

questions.prompt: We want to leave the path clear. Put the bag ____ the chair, where it will not block our feet.
questions.explanation: A under chair收包不占路；B横跨椅不表安全收处；C高悬above没有支撑且非给定收纳位置。

units.title: 活动中心参观时的应答

materials.title: Centre Visit Replies 032
materials.text:
Match each question with its best reply. Use every answer once.
A. Because the floor has just been cleaned.
B. The adult at the information desk.
C. After the guide finishes the short talk.
D. Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
E. In the folder with our group label.

questions.prompt: Why should we avoid the wet corner?
options: Because the floor has just been cleaned.
The adult at the information desk.
After the guide finishes the short talk.
Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
In the folder with our group label.
questions.explanation: A刚清洁地湿解释绕开；B人员、C时机、D空间许可、E夹位非原因。

questions.prompt: Who can help if we lose a name badge?
options: Because the floor has just been cleaned.
The adult at the information desk.
After the guide finishes the short talk.
Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
In the folder with our group label.
questions.explanation: B信息台成人答Who求助；A清洁原因、C导览后、D条件、E夹位均非人员。

questions.prompt: When may we ask our questions?
options: Because the floor has just been cleaned.
The adult at the information desk.
After the guide finishes the short talk.
Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
In the folder with our group label.
questions.explanation: C导游短讲后答时机；A湿角原因、B人员、D可坐条件、E夹位不答When。

questions.prompt: May we sit together on this long bench?
options: Because the floor has just been cleaned.
The adult at the information desk.
After the guide finishes the short talk.
Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
In the folder with our group label.
questions.explanation: D可以但给别人留空间，答同坐许可；A原因、B人、C讲后、E夹位均非座位条件。

questions.prompt: Where do we keep our drawing sheets during the visit?
options: Because the floor has just been cleaned.
The adult at the information desk.
After the guide finishes the short talk.
Yes, if you leave enough space for others.
In the folder with our group label.
questions.explanation: E本组标签夹答纸张存处；A原因、B人员、C时间、D座位许可均不答Where。

materials.title: Theatre Trip Bank 032
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and choose one bank word for each gap. Use each word once. Bank: A. along B. tickets C. arrive D. ready E. before
We walk ____1____ River Street until we reach the theatre. We ____2____ at nine thirty, half an hour before the show. The teacher gives us our ____3____ at the entrance. We put bags away ____4____ taking our seats. When everyone is seated, we are ____5____ for the first scene.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A along沿河街走；B tickets物、C arrive到达、D ready状态、E before时间均不作该沿街路径介词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C arrive at时间表到达；A along介词、B tickets名词、D ready形容词、E before连接词不作到达谓语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B入口领tickets票；A along、C arrive、D ready、E before均不是发给学生的物品名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: E before taking seats先收包后坐；A along不接动名词表达此时间，B tickets、C arrive、D ready均不连接该先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: D be ready for首幕准备好；A along、B tickets、C arrive、E before均不作所需状态表语。

units.title: 创作展准备时的五个问题

materials.title: Creative Fair Replies 032
materials.text:
Match each question to its best reply. Use each bank reply once.
A. The room named on the newest booking note.
B. Because the paint needs longer to dry.
C. The volunteer carrying the materials list.
D. After all the pieces have been counted.
E. Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.

questions.prompt: Which room should we use if two old messages disagree?
options: The room named on the newest booking note.
Because the paint needs longer to dry.
The volunteer carrying the materials list.
After all the pieces have been counted.
Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.
questions.explanation: A最新预约单室名答冲突信息取据；B干漆原因、C人、D点数时机、E样本许可均不辨房间。

questions.prompt: Why is our display still covered?
options: The room named on the newest booking note.
Because the paint needs longer to dry.
The volunteer carrying the materials list.
After all the pieces have been counted.
Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.
questions.explanation: B漆需更多干燥时间解释盖护；A新单室名、C人、D点数、E样本条件不答Why。

questions.prompt: Who can tell us whether more paper is available?
options: The room named on the newest booking note.
Because the paint needs longer to dry.
The volunteer carrying the materials list.
After all the pieces have been counted.
Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.
questions.explanation: C拿材料表志愿者答资源核对人员；A室名、B原因、D时间、E许可非Who。

questions.prompt: When may we close the box of model parts?
options: The room named on the newest booking note.
Because the paint needs longer to dry.
The volunteer carrying the materials list.
After all the pieces have been counted.
Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.
questions.explanation: D数齐后答合盒时机；A室、B漆因、C人、E样本许可不答When。

questions.prompt: May I examine this small sample?
options: The room named on the newest booking note.
Because the paint needs longer to dry.
The volunteer carrying the materials list.
After all the pieces have been counted.
Yes, but keep the sample inside its tray.
questions.explanation: E可以但留盘内答查看许可；A室名、B原因、C人、D点数时机均不答此条件。

materials.title: Fun Run Stone Eight Cloze 032
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose the best word for every numbered gap.
During the school fun run, Hana suddenly ____1____ while other children kept moving. She pointed to her ____2____ and said something hard was hurting near her toes. Rohan ____3____ to sit with her on a bench. He had first thought she simply needed a rest. When she took the shoe off, a small ____4____ fell out. Hana smiled ____5____ her foot no longer hurt. The event was not a timed race, so they continued ____6____ instead of trying to catch the fastest group. They finished as a ____7____. Rohan felt ____8____ of helping, even though his name was not among the earliest arrivals.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A stopped与others kept moving对比且脚疼需停；B煮、C印不合沿路跑情境。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B痛近脚趾且后文脱shoe；A帽、C围巾不包含脚趾。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C offered to sit主动陪坐；A画、B借均不接此提议不定式义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A小石可鞋内硌脚并落出；B椅、C窗不可能按本叙事大小在鞋内。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B脚不疼是笑原因；A选择、C除非条件不合已发生因果。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C非竞速且不追最快，slowly慢行；A愤怒无因；B square不表行进方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: A互助一起以team队伍完成；B云、C勺非两人结伴角色。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: B felt proud of helping为搭配与情绪；A空、C木制不表达帮助带来自豪。

units.title: 新老师的名字应该怎么念

materials.title: New Teacher Name Story 032
materials.text: Our new teacher’s name was unfamiliar to us. We copied a pronunciation from an old school video, assuming it must be right. When she introduced herself, the sound was different. One pupil wanted to correct her using the video. Our class captain suggested asking politely instead. The teacher explained that the video caption had linked her name to another person by mistake. She showed us the correct written name and said it slowly. We practised with her permission. Later, the school corrected the caption. I learned that an older recording could be useful evidence without being stronger than the person’s own clear introduction.

questions.prompt: The class first uses an old video to guess the pronunciation.
questions.explanation: A正确：copied pronunciation old video；B否认初取来源。

questions.prompt: The teacher’s introduction matches the class’s first guess exactly.
questions.explanation: B正确：sound different；A把不一致说完全一致。

questions.prompt: The captain suggests a polite question rather than an accusation.
questions.explanation: A正确：suggested asking politely，不直接按视频纠人；B否认沟通选择。

questions.prompt: The caption had mixed the teacher’s name with another person.
questions.explanation: A正确：linked name another person mistake；B否认出错原因。

questions.prompt: The school leaves the known caption mistake uncorrected.
questions.explanation: B正确：later corrected；A把后续修正说不改。

materials.title: Club Exhibition Word Forms 032
materials.text:
Use the correct one-word form of every given word to complete all five gaps.
1. Last month, our class ____1____ (bring) several models to the town hall.
2. The story on the safety display described how quick help saved three ____2____ (life).
3. The cleaned window is ____3____ (clean) than it was before the work.
4. Look! The goalkeeper is ____4____ (stop) a slow ball with both hands.
5. The organiser answered our question ____5____ (honest) about the missing materials.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use BRING.
questions.explanation: 接受brought：Last month过去，bring不规则；bring原形、bringed错误、bringing分词均不作过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use LIFE.
questions.explanation: 接受lives：three明确要求生命的复数，life变lives；life单数与three不合，lifes错误拼写，liveses重复加复数错误。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use CLEAN.
questions.explanation: 接受cleaner：than比较清洁程度；clean原级、cleanest最高级、cleanliness名词不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use STOP.
questions.explanation: 接受stopping：is进行，stop双写p加ing；stop原形、stoping错拼、stopped过去式不表正在拦球。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use HONEST.
questions.explanation: 明确接受honestly修饰answered表示如实回答；honesty名词不作方式副词，honester不是本句所需形式。其他未列形式按review处理。

units.title: 学习时请求真正有用的帮助

materials.title: Learning Help Functions 032
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each learner’s stated purpose.

questions.prompt: You are stuck on a maths problem and want the method explained rather than only the answer. What should you say?
options: Could you explain how to start this problem?
Please give me the answer and no explanation.
Could you remove every maths lesson?
questions.explanation: A请求起步方法实现理解目标；B只要答案相反；C取消数学非学习求助。

questions.prompt: A teacher writes "unclear" on your paragraph, and you need to know which part. What should you ask?
options: Could you show me which sentence needs clarification?
Can you throw away my whole notebook?
questions.explanation: B定位具体不清句；A泛化、C丢本不产生改进信息。

questions.prompt: You have two different due dates in your notes and want the current deadline confirmed. What should you ask?
options: May I choose whichever is later?
Does every date mean the same thing?
Could you confirm the current deadline for this task?
questions.explanation: C核当前任务期限；A自择晚日、B混同日期不求证。

questions.prompt: You want to hear how an unfamiliar word is pronounced. What should you say?
options: Could you say this word slowly so I can practise it?
Could you hide the word from me?
Could you write a longer exam?
questions.explanation: A请求慢念供练习；B隐藏、C加长考试不提供发音示范。

questions.prompt: You will miss a workshop and want to know how to catch up. What should you ask?
options: Can everyone stop learning until I return?
What materials or steps should I use to catch up after missing the workshop?
May I claim that I attended?
questions.explanation: B询补学材料步骤；A停全体、C虚称出席不弥补学习。
